facts.fact: StackAdapt was selected as a winner in the Connected TV/Over-the-Top (CTV/OTT) Product/Platform category of the 2026 ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards, according to StackAdapt's own announcement.
facts.quote: today announced the company has been selected as a winner in the Connected TV/Over-the-Top (CTV/OTT) Product/Platform category for the 2026 ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards.

facts.fact: ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards entries were scored by an external jury of industry experts and reviewed by the ADWEEK Editorial Team.
facts.quote: Entries were scored by an external jury of industry experts and reviewed by the ADWEEK Editorial Team.
